summary: Nucleus v2 (renamed from Tessera) frontend tested end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844 via Expo web preview. All reviewed subset features work: (1) Onboarding renders 'Nucleus' branding (no residual 'Tessera' on Today), themes switch via onboarding-theme-paper / onboarding-theme-midnight, finish-sample-button loads sample data and Today shows today-trip-tile, today-home-tile, today-budget-tile, today-online-toggle, capture-input. (2) Capture bar correctly parses '450 food lunch' -> Expense (Food) [budget went ₹32,211 -> ₹33,181 after adding ₹450+₹520], 'netflix 649 monthly' -> Subscription, 'fuel 5L 520' -> Fuel entry on default Activa + linked Money expense ('Saved · Fuel · Activa · 5 L · ₹520' toast), invalid text shows hint 'Try: 450 food lunch · fuel 5.4L 560 · netflix 649 monthly' and save button hidden. (3) Online switch defaults OFF (chip shows 'Offline'), toggling shows 'Online'; after online use netlog-sheet populates (netlog-empty gone, open-meteo entries visible). (4) Settings city search: Bengaluru -> settings-city-result-0 selected -> Today shows today-weather-tile with 7-day forecast from Open-Meteo. (5) Travel flow: travel-add-button opens trip-sheet, trip-save-button navigates to detail; Beach template populates 12 pack items, pack-item toggle moves trip-readiness-pct 20%->24%, pack-add-input+button adds items. (6) Itinerary: trip-add-stop-button opens stop-sheet (stop-day-1, stop-time-input='09:00', stop-title-input='Beach walk', stop-save-button) and stop appears in Day-1 timeline. (7) Spend: trip-expense-cur-USD + amount 10 + rate 83 -> trip-expense-converted shows '= 830 INR', trip-spent updates to ₹830 after save. (8) Docs: 4 doc-toggle-* chips toggle; trip-why-button opens why-sheet. (9) Home: /home shows home-hero, home-timeline, 3 appliance-card-*, maint-done -> maint-log-sheet with maint-cost-input=800 and maint-log-save completes; home-add-button opens appliance-sheet (name/room-Kitchen/plan-name+plan-add/appliance-save), card count 3->4; room chips filter. (10) Attention tab shows warranty 'Bedroom AC warranty ends in 21 days' and trip readiness ('Packing 67%'); maintenance overdue is reflected on Home 'NEXT MAINTENANCE 3d late · AC service' (not under /attention tab list though). (11) All 5 themes (paper/amoled/dune/graphite/midnight) switch colors without layout breakage on Today, Travel, Home. (12) Regression: Vehicles (Activa + Swift sample data), Tools, Modules all render; PIN flow via settings-lock-switch + settings-pin-key-* twice succeeds with 'App lock is on' toast. One minor runtime issue: restcountries.com API triggers CORS error on web preview (does not block any user-visible feature, geocoding/weather/rates work).

integration_issues.issue: CORS error: 'Access to fetch at https://restcountries.com/v3.1/alpha/IN?fields=... blocked by CORS policy'. Appears to be fired when settings/online code resolves country info. Weather (Open-Meteo) and geocoding work; this call fails silently but logs an error to console. Should be wrapped so the thrown error does not spam console or should use a CORS-safe endpoint.

react_native_issues.issue: Previous iteration reported 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on sheet overlays. Not re-verified this round; recommend confirming fix in Sheet.tsx.

action_items: Investigate restcountries.com CORS error on web preview. Either (a) move the call behind a try/catch that silently caches a known-failure for CORS to prevent repeated attempts, (b) use a CORS-enabled mirror, or (c) hide the dependent feature when the fetch fails. Reference: /app/frontend/src/core/online.ts:91.
If not already fixed, replace deprecated pointerEvents prop usage with style.pointerEvents in overlay/sheet components (carryover).
critical_code_review_comments: Capture bar parser is well-designed: shows live preview chip ('Will create: ...') and hides capture-save-button for invalid input while surfacing a hint ('Try: ...'). Good UX for freeform ingestion.
Trip expense manual-rate flow is sensible for offline cases: converted amount (= 830 INR) updates reactively from amount*rate before save and trip-spent reflects the saved value.
Online toggle gates all network fetches cleanly (netlog-empty remains until toggled on; Open-Meteo requests appear in the log only after Online is enabled). Good privacy posture.
Beach template -> 12 items with 20% readiness confirms readiness is computed over total pack items; toggling first item moves pct to 24% as expected.
Home maintenance Log sheet correctly creates a linked Money expense (same pattern as fuel) and reports via toast; good consistency.
Sample data persistence across route changes is solid: Vehicles still shows Activa + Swift and tile budget totals match capture mutations.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all listed review features pass; only cosmetic CORS console error on restcountries)

seed_data_creation: Used in-app onboarding-finish-sample-button (Activa + Swift, Goa 2026 trip, Bedroom AC + 2 appliances, 6 months of transactions, 4 subscriptions, ₹45,000 budget).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clear localStorage between independent scenarios. Mobile viewport 390x844. Onboarding = 3 x onboarding-next-button then onboarding-finish-sample-button. Online toggle testID = today-online-toggle (shows 'Offline' / 'Online' text). Trip detail route /travel/[id] has tabs trip-tabs-pack/plan/spend/docs; expense sheet uses trip-expense-cur-USD, trip-expense-amount-input, trip-expense-rate-input, trip-expense-converted, trip-expense-save-button. Home maintenance sheet uses maint-cost-input + maint-log-save. Appliance sheet uses appliance-name-input + appliance-room-Kitchen + plan-name-input + plan-add-button + appliance-save-button. Weather & geocoding require today-online-toggle (or settings-online-switch) ON.
rca_of_issue: CORS error on https://restcountries.com: the public restcountries.com v3.1 endpoint does not emit Access-Control-Allow-Origin for arbitrary origins when served via the Expo preview hostname, so the browser blocks the request. The feature is non-critical (country metadata enrichment) and failure is swallowed by onlineFetch, but it does leak a console error on every settings-online-switch=on + relevant screen. Mitigation: either skip the restcountries call on web entirely (Platform.OS === 'web' guard), front it with a CORS-permissive proxy, or cache a static fallback for IN/common country codes.
